name: Santa Fe
tagline: Adobe art city in the high desert
summary: Santa Fe is a 400-year-old adobe capital at 2,100 m, famous for its art: Canyon Road galleries, the Georgia O'Keeffe Museum and Meow Wolf's immersive installation. It's also known for red-or-green chile cuisine and Pueblo culture nearby.
seasonNote: Summer has markets and monsoon storms; autumn is golden; winter brings snow and farolitos.
arrival: Fly into Albuquerque (1 hour) or Santa Fe's small airport.
gettingAround: Walk the plaza; car for Taos and Bandelier.
cashTip: Cards and tap work almost everywhere. Tip 18-22% at restaurants and a dollar or two per drink at bars.
foodTip: Green chile everything, sopaipillas and posole.
buyTip: Native American jewellery under the Palace portal.
